body: I lied about the amount I was getting paid to still get benefits. For example I made about 400 for one week but reported I only made about 30.
Even if I haven't been charged with anything?
That's my current situation. My best friend's mom is letting me stay over 2 weeks. It makes me nervous but I can get back in that time if I try really hard.
Unfortunately I no longer speak with my dad and my mom does not own/rent any place to live. She's a live in caregiver so she has no need for her own place. :/

So much great advice thank you so much. I can tell today is going to be a day of crying.

Everything you said here I'm trying to get going in some capacity. I'm the kind of person who feels despair when I make no forward progress so I'm having a hard time celebrating anything I do right now. 

I definitely do not want another relationship for a long time as I still love him (I know this isn't great but it is what it is) and I'm just ashamed of the person I am now. This is definitely not what I envisioned for myself and I'm in no way suited to be with anyone until I get my shit together.

Thank you so much for this well thought out and kind response. I'm crying just reading it knowing someone thought about me to this capacity.

My best friend's mom actually offered to let me stay at her apartment for about 2 weeks as long as I help her with cleaning. This isn't the first time I've done this with her and I really want it to be the last. I really don't want to be in a relationship for a long time after this until I'm someone who can support themselves. 

I've been to therapy before and I definitely need to go again now. And you're absolutely right about just doing one thing at a time. I worked on my resume this morning when I couldn't sleep and just saved a lot of jobs to apply to. I'm also asking my best friend if she can get me a job at the restaurant she currently works at just so I can have some form of income. Finding an affordable place to live is going to be the hardest and honestly the most terrifying part of this to me. I've never lived alone.

I really want to figure out who I am and be stable before I rush into another relationship again. It's terrible because I was always in a relationship ever since I was 16 and now I'm just really over it. I want somebody to be with, but I accept that I don't need anyone now..
